newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Hong Kong investment in Philippines soars.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong investment in Philippines soars.

text.p: Hong Kong investment in the Philippines soared 645 percent last year making the British colony the top investor in the country, the Department of Trade and Industry said here on Friday.
Documents from the government agency showed that Hong Kong company investment rose to 7.33 billion pesos in 1996, up from 983 million pesos in 1995.
The United States was top investor in 1995.

Trade Undersecretary Melito Salazar said the boost in Hong Kong investment may be due to efforts by the government to attract Hong Kong-based companies ahead of the colony's return to mainland China in July.
The DTI added that last year 32 new multinational companies decided to locate their regional headquarters in the Philippines.
